headline: President Bush created a White House office focused on faith-based and community groups that provide social services.
what_it_does: This executive order set up a new office inside the White House called the Office of Faith-Based and Community Initiatives. Based on the title, the office was meant to lead the administration's work with religious and community organizations. No summary was provided, so the office's specific duties and powers are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They became the focus of a new White House office dealing with groups like theirs.

who_it_affects.group: White House and federal executive staff
who_it_affects.how: A new office was added to the White House structure.
